title: Auf dem Schiff
desc: The bus on the water, and it is faster
setting: A landing stage behind the station, thirty people, half of them with rucksacks.

options.feedback: Say the card at the same time. She is about to ask, and half the queue behind you has one.
Fine. Then comes: mit Halbtax? and then the price twice over.
The boat goes in six minutes. Buy the return, it costs less than two singles.

steps.speaker: Frau am Schalter
steps.es: Gilt auch für den Bus zurück.
steps.en: It is valid for the bus back too.

options.feedback: One ticket from A to B, and whatever runs in between is your business. Train, bus, boat, the same card.

options.en: Do I have to buy anything else?
options.feedback: No. That is exactly what she just told you.
Good question, and the answer is usually no. Mountain railways are their own thing, and the Halbtax still halves them.

steps.speaker: Mann an Bord
steps.en: Are you sitting up top or below?

options.es: Oben. Ich bin noch nicht so lange hier.
options.en: Up top. I have not been here that long.
options.feedback: Honest, and he will laugh. Tourists sit up top; everybody else sits below with the newspaper.
The local answer. It is thirty-five minutes and you have seen the lake before.
It is not. He was making conversation, which is the whole thing that happens on a boat.

options.es: Und es fährt noch jeden Tag?
options.en: And it still runs every day?
options.feedback: It does, in the timetable, with tickets. That is the part worth being surprised by, and he will tell you all of it.
He opened a door. One question and you get twenty minutes about the engine.
It does. That is a steam engine and there is a man standing next to it whose whole job is watching it.
